pet_notes: Authoritative identity is Spica G version2.0.0. Smooth FULLY CLOSED pale buttery-gold round ring, thick dark navy outline, opaque round navy face disk, exactly TWO white half-disc sleepy eyes with NO pupils, tiny knowing white smile, TWO small rounded gold feet. ONE gold classic crescent OPENING RIGHT with ONE four-point gold star nestled in opening, in upper-screen-right NAVY FACE above the right eye. Crescent and star must retain navy space around them, never touch ring or eyes, never connect to ring. Optional details present in base: upper-left ring three-dot constellation, lower-right Virgo glyph, two lilac cheek ticks per side. Flat clean illustration and cute/slightly suspicious sleepy mood. NO inward curl, spiral, ring breaks, hands, fingers, arms, finger-like protrusions, hats, props, clothing or extra stars. Never mirror because moon/star and Virgo placement are asymmetric. Animate by eyes/mouth, gentle body breathing and attached rounded feet. Wave only with a small lift/tilt of one LOWER foot attached at bottom rim; never grow an arm or use crescent as limb. Jump lift is SMALL, 8 percent of body height; body size stays identical to idle. In gaze rows body/feet/ring/marks are fixed; flat white eye pair/mouth/cheeks move naturally on navy surface, original eye design retained, BOTH eyes always visible and not overlapping moon/star.
